items.desc: A flaw was found in dnsmasq. When following a CNAME in a DNS response, the resolver can cache records for the CNAME target without checking that those records belong to the responding server's authorized zone. Later clients may then receive attacker-chosen addresses for those names.

items.desc: A flaw was found in dnsmasq. The TCP DNS service uses a small fixed pool of child processes and does not set a receive timeout on client connections. UDP DNS resolution continues, and occupied slots are released after a fixed lifetime.
